issues.concern: The gloss 'to say, to tell' is incomplete as it misses the nuance of 'to call (a name)' or 'to be called (a name)', which is a common usage of 言う.
issues.suggestion: Add 'to call (a name)' or 'to be called (a name)' to the main gloss, perhaps as 'to say, to tell, to call'.
